draft_off.question: How will my career go, which field will i work in, when will i leave my current job
shown: For your career, most of what the chart shows agrees, and on balance it leans favourably.
The divisional chart for your career leans favourably; there Mars falls in Capricorn, exalted, where it is at its best.
The planets that signify your career lean favourably; among them, the Sun sits in Aquarius in your 10th house, in an unfriendly sign.
The ruler of your 10th house, Saturn, sits in your 1st house, which drains it; it is in a feeble state by its degree in Taurus; and it has less strength than it needs to give fully what it promises.
A chart cannot give a date for leaving or changing a job; it shows the period you are in and the stretches it reads as more and less favourable for your career.
You are in the period of Jupiter, within that of Mercury, until November 2028; Jupiter and Mercury have a hand in your career.
The most favourable stretch for your career, as the chart reads it, runs from October 2029 to June 2032.
Looking at the stretches the chart shows, the least favourable one runs from November 2028 to August 2029.
Neither of these two stretches is a prediction of when you will act.
